## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the work-board task and any
relevant decision. State whether this changes the agreed Level 0 scope.

## Validation

Record the checks actually run and their results. For documents, check links,
headings, and scope consistency. For code, include exact commands and material
coverage limits. State what remains unverified.

## Review and follow-up

Identify unresolved questions, required reviewer, and next action, if any. Update
the work board with the result and evidence. For a handoff, name the affected paths.
